profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Brewer Science
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I’m currently working as a a full stack software engineer at Brewer Science. I have a background in teaching English as a Second Language and Customer Service. Some of the skills that I acquired in those positions and have implemented in my role as a software engineer include leadership, active listening, problem solving, communication, critical thinking, patience, and organization.

Technical skills: I've worked with React, Express, Node, Django, MongoDB, Python, jQuery, Bootstrap, HTML, CSS, etc to build full stack web applications.

You can check out my personal site at rosydiazl.github.io/

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Develop cloud-based applications using technologies such as React, AWS Lambda, MySQL,
and Jest, to deliver user-friendly, scalable solutions that enhance efficiency and user
satisfaction for internal customers.
• Collaborate on the Enterprise Applications team to resolve technical issues by gathering
business requirements, implementing new features, addressing bugs, and managing support
tickets, leading to improved service quality and streamlined employee workflows.

positions.title: Software Developer I
positions.description:
• Developed custom document generation software using Python, Node.js, Express and
MongoDB, significantly enhancing the user experience for veterans applying for disability
benefits.
• Worked in an Agile Scrum environment, utilizing the Atlassian product suite to boost service
quality, productivity, and team efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineering Immersive Fellow
positions.description:
• Built four full-stack web applications using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python and various
frameworks, deepening knowledge of software engineering principles and best practices.
• Collaborated with a diverse group of software engineering fellows, gaining practical
experience in pair programming and Agile methodologies to improve project outcomes.

positions.title: English as a Second Language Teacher
positions.description:
• Led classes and activities for adult learners, enabling them to improve their lives by acquiring
English as second language.
• Wrote and implemented daily lesson plans focused on essay writing and language skills,
creating a structured learning environment with clear objectives and measurable student
progress.

company.name: Ministerio de Educación Superior, Ciencia y Tecnología (MESCyT)

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
• Resolved customer inquiries via phone and email for U.S. and Canadian clients, ensuring timely and
effective solutions to issues related to orders, refunds, and reshipments.
• Documented detailed reports for every customer interaction, tracking issues and solutions to
improve service efficiency and enhance customer satisfaction.
